_comment: Hand-computed expected values for the DMOPS-001 fixture study — the
known-truth side of the metric qualification tests (DM-Q*). The fixture
is deliberately small enough to verify by hand; every number below was
computed from the CSVs, not from the code under test.
Reporting period: 2026-06-01 .. 2026-06-30 inclusive.
query_tat_median: closed-in-June TATs are site 001 [2,3,4,6,10] and
site 002 [1,5,7,8]; Q-090/Q-091 closed in May and cancelled Q-092 are
excluded. query_open_aging as of 2026-06-30: open/answered are Q-301
entry_lag: pages first entered in June with a dated, occurred visit give
lags [2,3,5,7,9]; the May-entered page and never-entered pages are
excluded.
v1.1 (business days, Mon–Fri UTC; weekends in June 2026 are 6–7, 13–14,
20–21, 27–28): a business day counts if it is a weekday strictly after
the clock-start date, up to and including the clock-stop date.
query_tat_median v1.1: site 001 [2,1,4,4,8] (e.g. Q-102 opened Fri 6/5,
closed Mon 6/8 → 1; Q-105 opened Mon 6/8, closed Thu 6/18 → 8) and
site 002 [1,4,5,5] (e.g. Q-202 opened Sat 6/6, closed Thu 6/11 → 4;
Q-204 opened Fri 6/12, closed Sat 6/20 → 5).
entry_lag v1.1: lags [2,3,3,5,5] (e.g. 001-001 V3 visit Wed 6/10,
entered Mon 6/15 → 3; 002-001 V1 visit Fri 6/5, entered Sun 6/14 → 5).
